errors.evidence: The description states the shortest bar has a value of approximately 0.2, but the chart shows this bar (Greedy (CodeLlama-7B) for the EGP metric) has a value very close to 0.0, approximately 0.01.

errors.text_span: докато най-високата стълба е в категорията CCP, достигаща приблизително 0.9
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the highest bar as being in the CCP category. The actual highest bar is in the EGP category (for RPG (CodeLlama-34B)) and its value is approximately 0.98, not 0.9.

The description fails to mention that this is a grouped bar chart, where the four data series are grouped under each metric on the x-axis. The prompt explicitly asks to describe the grouping or stacking if present.
The color for RPG (CodeLlama-34B) is more accurately described as burnt orange rather than brown ('кафяви').

errors.text_span: There are four sets of grouped bars, each representing a different model
errors.evidence: The chart has four groups of bars, but each group represents a metric from the x-axis (EGP, TR-N, etc.). The bars within each group represent the different models, not the other way around.
The model name is consistently misspelled as "CodeLLama" instead of "CodeLlama" as shown in the legend.

errors.text_span: The "Greedy (CodeLLama-7B)" bars have values approximately ranging from 0.3 to 0.7
errors.evidence: The actual range for the blue bars (Greedy (CodeLlama-7B)) is from approximately 0.01 (for EGP) to 0.7 (for TR-N and TR-S). The lower bound of 0.3 is significantly incorrect.

errors.text_span: the "RPG (CodeLLama-7B)" bars range approximately from 0.4 to 0.8
errors.evidence: The actual range for the golden orange bars (RPG (CodeLlama-7B)) is from approximately 0.42 (for TR-S) to 0.89 (for EGP). The stated upper bound of 0.8 is inaccurate.

errors.text_span: the "Greedy (CodeLLama-34B)" bars range from roughly 0.4 to 0.9
errors.evidence: The actual range for the green bars (Greedy (CodeLlama-34B)) is from approximately 0.45 (for TR-S) to 0.7 (for CCP). The stated upper bound of 0.9 is significantly incorrect.
The description omits the label for the horizontal axis, which is "Metrics".

errors.text_span: The bars are sorted by the order of the metrics on the horizontal axis
errors.evidence: This statement is tautological and uninformative. It doesn't clarify whether there is a meaningful sorting order (e.g., alphabetical, by value) or not.
